_comment: Filing-mapping ratchet baseline (scripts/filing_mapping_report.py --check). placed_cells may not DECREASE; unplaced_figures, structure_findings and error_rule_breaks, and every cell of their breakdowns (unplaced_by_reason, structure_by_table, error_rules_by_rule), may not INCREASE. Re-measure with --update-baseline after a deliberate change and say why in _note; never type the numbers.
_note: First bank (rwa-filer Phase 2), extended in Phase 3 with structure_findings. placed/unplaced are unchanged from the first bank: 1911 distinct cells land on a PRA001 v4.1.1 data point; 1025 distinct non-zero figures do not, 816 of them because our IRB sheets (OF 08.01-08.05) are per exposure class while the published sheet axis also splits by approach and SME / non-SME. structure_findings is new: 8 placed facts cannot be filed as generated. STR007 OF02.00.01.01 - rows 0050 and 0060 (and OF 07.00 total sheet c0220) are one data point in the taxonomy and hold different values. STR007 OF08.01.01.01 - c0276 (output-floor RWEA) disagrees with the OF 02.00 c0020 cell that is the same data point. STR007 OF02.01.01.03 - r0080 c0030 (U-TREA) disagrees with OF 02.00 r0010 c0010. STR006 OF08.03.01.01 - c0080 is an integer metric and we report a fractional maturity. The adapter now writes the yes/no cell OF 02.00 r0034 c0030 as true/false, which removed the STR006 it produced in all 13 portfolios before this bank. 2026-11-13: error_rule_breaks added - the Error-severity rules of the v4.1.1 rule book that the placed return breaks, as (rule, portfolio) pairs: 128 pairs over 33 rules. Banked as found, to hold the list while it is worked down. Not all 33 are defects in the estate: boe_b0710 (OF 07.00 c0150 against the off-balance-sheet conversion-factor breakdown, on rows that include the on-balance-sheet total) cannot hold for a return that follows Annex II's own definition of columns 0160-0190, and boe_b0778 / boe_b0779 contradict each other on OF 08.07 c0050; tests/expected_outputs/reporting/validation_known_breaks.json records the analysis of each. 2026-11-13 (second bank): OF 09.02 RWEA moved from column 0125 to its published column 0110. placed_cells 1911 -> 1935 and unplaced_figures 1025 -> 1001 (the 24 c09_02 column_not_in_taxonomy figures now have a cell). error_rule_breaks 128 -> 132, read rule by rule: boe_b0278 and boe_b0296 (OF 09.02 RWEA against the OF 08.01 institutions and QRRE sheets) now HOLD; boe_b0284, boe_b0293, boe_b0302, boe_b1055 and boe_b1060 now break. Those five are the RWEA members of the 'OF 09.02 country total = OF 08.01 sheet' family whose exposure members (boe_b0282, b0283, b0291, b0292, b0301, b1053, b1054, b1058, b1059) were already breaking for the same reason - the OF 08.01 corporate and retail sheets are not placed (sheet_coarser_than_published_axis). They were not evaluated before only because the OF 09.02 side was empty too. Owner: the OF 08 sheet split. 2026-11-13 (third bank): OF 08.07 no longer reports its three share columns (0030, 0040, 0050) as 0.0 on a row with no exposure - each is a quotient over the row's column 0020 (PS1/26 Annex II 3.3.10.2) and is now left empty. error_rule_breaks 132 -> 119 over 34 rules: boe_b0778 (c0030 + c0040 + c0050 = 1) broke on all thirteen portfolios and now breaks on none. No other rule's count moved; placed_cells, unplaced_figures and structure_findings are unchanged (a 0.0 share was never a placed figure). boe_b0779 still breaks on four portfolios and is not this defect - validation_known_breaks.json records why. 2026-11-13 (fourth bank): OF 07.00 no longer reports a figure in a cell the published template greys out. unplaced_figures 1001 -> 954; c07_00|cell_not_reportable 52 -> 5 distinct cells. The five that remain are memorandum row 0320 on the 'in default' sheet: Annex II 3.2.2 para 55 asks for it there and the taxonomy publishes rows 0300/0320 on sheets 0001-0004 and 0007-0009 only - the open question recorded as P1.377, not a grey cell. placed_cells, structure_findings and error_rule_breaks did not move.
